title: NWSConnectDocumentMetadata
description: Metadata for an NWS Connect document.

startTime.description: The time when the document becomes active. ISO8601 datetime.

endTime.description: The time when the document becomes inactive. ISO8601 datetime.

updateTime.description: When the document was last updated. ISO8601 datetime.

priority.description: An indicator that a weather story should be emphasized.

download.description: The URL of the media content for the weather story.
